validationScope: Citation and provenance audit of active data and rendered sources. 37 existing regression groups plus a new citation-integrity checker passed. remainingCitationLimits: HTTP HEAD success is not proof of accessible full text or source accuracy. Some successful redirects reach cookie or anti-bot pages. Publisher 403s are access limits, not confirmed broken citations.
